acceptance: The next scheduled baseline refresh pull request gets an oracle verdict and merges (or the stall is documented with the owner of the fix)
If refresh pull requests cannot be reviewed reliably, a decision records whether to keep the baseline directory as a soundness path
context: Soundness paths are listed in .github/soundness-paths.txt. The refresh workflow is fast-duration-baseline-refresh.yml and creates a pull request titled to refresh the baseline. The change was added to satisfy review findings that a pull request could otherwise edit the gate and its own baseline unreviewed.
description: The blocking duration gate made scripts/build_fast_duration_baseline.py, scripts/fast_tier_calibration.py, tests/duration_policy.py, tests/__init__.py and tests/fixtures/fast_tier_baseline/ oracle-reviewed soundness paths. The scheduled workflow that refreshes the baseline opens a pull request touching that directory, so each refresh now needs an oracle verdict and may stall. This was not exercised before the change merged.
